skill.name: aippt
skill.description: Generate presentation images and package them into a PPTX by analyzing an existing template, planning content, and using image generation prompts.
skill.summary: A guided workflow for turning source content and a presentation template into a styled PPTX.
skill.author: Ceeon

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown formatting, npm lockfile metadata, or heuristic entropy checks. The workflow does make intentional external requests, including uploads of local presentation images to third-party hosts and calls to an image-generation API. No prompt-injection text, embedded secret, or obfuscated executable payload was found.

remediation.issue: Presentation images may be uploaded to public third-party hosts.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before every upload, explain that the image leaves the local environment, and provide a private or self-hosted storage option.

remediation.issue: The freeimage.host API key is embedded in documentation.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the shared key from the skill and require users to supply their own credential through a secure local configuration method.

remediation.issue: External image-generation requests can send sensitive prompts or image references.
remediation.suggestion: Document the destination, data sent, retention considerations, and a confirmation step before submitting each API request.

content.value_statement: Creating a consistent presentation from existing content and a template takes repeated layout work. This workflow plans slides, preserves template style, generates page images, and packages a PPTX file.
actual_capabilities: Export presentation templates to reference images through documented desktop and command-line methods.
Analyze template pages into a reusable layout library with editable and fixed regions.
Split source content into a page plan with page types and key messages.
Write image-generation prompts that preserve a template visual style.
Document image upload and image-generation API steps.
Package ordered image files into a 16:9 PPTX using the documented Node command.
limitations: The skill does not include the referenced scripts or configuration files in this package.
Image uploads and image-generation API calls require external services and user-managed credentials.
Generated images can change text, logos, or layout details and need visual review.
The workflow documents commands but does not guarantee that required desktop tools or dependencies are installed.

use_cases.title: Prepare a client proposal deck
use_cases.description: Turn a proposal outline into a slide plan that follows an approved corporate template.

use_cases.title: Create a training presentation
use_cases.description: Break lesson content into clear sections and map each section to consistent visual layouts.

use_cases.title: Produce recurring business updates
use_cases.description: Reuse a reporting template to create new visual slides from monthly source material.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a simple deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my content to create a 10-slide PPT plan. List each slide title, page type, and one key message.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a template
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these template reference images. Identify reusable layouts, fixed design elements, editable regions, and suitable content for each layout.

prompt_templates.title: Map content to layouts
prompt_templates.prompt: Map this page plan to the template layout library. For each slide, explain the selected layout and draft a visual-generation prompt that preserves fixed elements.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a production checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production checklist for this presentation. Include image review, external upload consent, API request review, file naming, and final PPTX validation.

output_examples.input: A 2,000-word product launch brief and a five-page brand template.
output: A 15-slide page plan with cover, agenda, product, benefits, timeline, and closing pages.
A layout assignment for each slide and review notes for fixed brand elements.

output_examples.input: A set of numbered slide images ready for packaging.
output: A file-order checklist for the images.
A documented command to package the images into a 16:9 PPTX file.

best_practices: Review every generated slide for correct text, logos, and brand elements before packaging.
Use private or approved storage for presentation images and confirm before any external upload.
Keep API keys outside prompts and documentation, using a secure local configuration method.
anti_patterns: Do not upload confidential client, employee, or financial presentation images to public image hosts.
Do not treat generated images as final copy without checking text accuracy and layout quality.
Do not use a shared API key embedded in documentation for production work.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It guides template analysis, content planning, image generation steps, and packaging of slide images into a PPTX file.

faq.question: Do I need an existing presentation template?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow is designed to use template pages as visual references and layout constraints.

faq.question: Does the package include the PPTX script?
faq.answer: No. The documentation references a packaging script, but that script is not included in this package.

faq.question: Are external services required?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow uses image hosting and an image-generation API for image-based slide creation.

faq.question: Can I use sensitive presentation material?
faq.answer: Use only approved private storage and services. Do not upload sensitive material to public image hosts.

faq.question: Will the generated slides be ready to deliver?
faq.answer: Not always. Review every image for text, branding, visual quality, and order before creating the final PPTX.
